A current transformer is a transformer in which the secondary 
 current is within specified limits proportional to and in-phase with the 
 primary current.

The purpose of this current transformer is to transform the actual system 
 current to a value suitable for supplying measuring instruments and protective 
 devices.

 circuit.

Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
 from one month to three months as indicated by M1:3 in the title block.
A current transformer is a transformer in which the secondary 
 current is within specified limits proportional to and in-phase with the 
 primary current.
The purpose of this current transformer is to transform the actual system 
 current to a value suitable for supplying measuring instruments and protective 
 devices.
 At the same time, it serves to insulate the measuring circuit from the primary 
 circuit.
The technical specification for the current transformer :
1Φ transformer, 2500/5A, 150 VA and 50 Hz frequency
This document initiated by eng. Shaimaa Abd Elazeem, tested by eng. Hany Heshmat 
 and Maher Abd El-Gawad Salem, approved by general manager eng. Mohamed 
 Salah Eldin Abd Elghafar.
Safety 
Precautions
A work order must be issued and 
 qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area
Wear your safety helmet and safety 
 shoes when cleaning
Transformer isolation and proper 
 grounded on all its sides are required
Before commencing work make sure 
 that the machine is isolated from the power supply and make sure again by 
 making use of electric detector that the circuit is dead
Presence of the safety supervisor is 
 required
Caution
Secondary CT wiring could be 
 energized through back feeds, make sure secondary circuit is short circuited
Tools 
and Equipment
Blower, voltmeter, screw driver 
 set, and fiberglass PVC ladder
Voltage indicator, portable earth 
 for discharging
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes
Complete maintenance tool set
Work to be 
carried out
Remove all dust from the transformer, particularly from insulating and cast 
 resin surface
Check the cable and bolted connection of the two side of the CT and ensure 
 that all parts are secure
Check for any signs of oil leaks
Clean all parts subject to corrosion should bed from time to time and their 
 surface given protective treatment
Check primary bus connection for tightness
Check for signs of overheating or flashover
